subject: Onboarding Contract Kickoff — MSA & Order Form: residency evidence and signer path
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>; Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract kickoff: MSA + Order Form — initial materials and residency asks

Hi Neha / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick connect earlier. We're ready to kick off the MSA + Order Form intake for Acme Health. Attaching the first-pass MSA and a populated order form for your review. A couple of priority items from our side so we can scope the redlines and evidence requests: 

- Data residency: we need confirmation of where workloads will be hosted for PHI-adjacent workloads (US only for now). Please confirm region options and whether a dedicated tenant is required for EU/other geos.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), network architecture diagram, and KMS/HSM details for customer key management (if available).
- Signatory path: who at Redwood will sign (legal entity name) and billing contact for PO/invoice.

Tentative timeline: we'd like to get initial redline comments back within 10 business days if possible so procurement can slot the contract for review. We're flexible on process — if you prefer annotated Word or redline through DocuSign, let us know.

Attachments: Acme_MSA_draft_20270617.docx; OrderForm_Acme_20270617.xlsx; SOC2_report_2025.pdf (redacted).

Proposed kickoff slots next week: Mon 6/21 10:00-10:30 PT or Tue 6/22 14:00-14:30 PT.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Legal Operations | Acme Health
procurement@acmehealth.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract kickoff: MSA + Order Form — initial materials and residency asks

Hi Samira — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. Looping in Kimberly (Legal) for the redline approach and Marissa (Contracts ops) to capture party/billing details and run the intake checklist.

Quick answers and next steps from our side:
- We can support US-only hosting in our standard hosted offering (US-EAST and US-WEST) under the standard data residency options. For EU/other regions we offer dedicated deployments; we'll confirm lead times once we know expected throughput and model types.
- Please confirm the legal entity name that will be on the signature line and the primary billing contact (name, email, PO number if known).
- We'll need the SOC2 report and network diagram (PDFs are fine) and contact for security ops to exchange an evidence checklist.

Kimberly — any specific redline format preference? Marissa — I'll let you sync on billing + signer.

I'll put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) with owners and a suggested 10-business-day milestone for initial comments; happy to extend if Acme needs more time. If the DocuSign flow is preferred we'll accept a redline that two parties agree on and then finalize in DocuSign.

Proposed kickoff: Mon 6/21 10:00 PT works for me. Sending a calendar invite after we confirm.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Lead — Commercial | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>; Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract kickoff: MSA + Order Form — initial materials and residency asks

Thanks — tagging a few practical items from legal to help speed intake: 

1) Signatory / entity: please confirm the exact corporate name (including LLC/Inc) and whether the signer will be authorized to execute subscription addenda or only the MSA.
2) Hosting / residency: if Acme requires a dedicated tenant or contractual residency guarantees (e.g., explicit clause limiting cross-border transfers), flag that now — it changes deployment and SLA options.
3) Evidence: we'll need the full SOC 2 Type II PDF (not just redacted excerpts) and the last 12 months of change control evidence for infra controls if possible. Network diagram and encryption-at-rest details (cipher, KMS provider) are also required.
4) Redline format: please provide a tracked-change Word document for the MSA and a separate annotated order form (XLSX with comments preferred). If Acme prefers to circulate comments via a collaborative Google Doc, we'll accept that but request a downloadable Word/PDF export for our legal record.

We typically do an initial legal pass, call out high-priority commercial clauses (liability caps, indemnity, data residency), and circulate a marked draft back to the customer. For PHI-adjacent customers we'll also confirm whether we need an addendum concerning HIPAA obligations — if so, call that out.

I've attached a short checklist (Redline_Instructions.pdf) to guide formatting and evidence submission.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>; Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elliot Rouse <elliot.rouse@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract kickoff: MSA + Order Form — initial materials and residency asks

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Attached are the files you requested (full SOC2 PDF included). We will provide the exact legal entity name and billing PO by end of day Monday.

Attachments: Acme_MSA_draft_20270617.docx; OrderForm_Acme_20270617.xlsx; SOC2_report_2025.pdf.

We prefer the tracked-change Word for the MSA. For the order form comments we'll add cell-level notes in the spreadsheet. DocuSign is fine for final execution — we'll wait for your redline and MAP before pushing it to signatures.

Kickoff confirmed: Mon 6/21 10:00 PT — Samira / Elliot / procurement on our side; Neha / Kimberly / Marissa on Redwood side. I'll accept the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Samira
